raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: S3 bucket for application user uploads with secure defaults and access controls.

Parameters:
  UploadsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Globally unique name for the S3 bucket to store application user uploads.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: S3 bucket name must be 3-63 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, dots, and hyphens.
  AllowedCorsOrigins:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: https://app.example.com
    Description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS on the uploads bucket.
  NoncurrentVersionExpirationDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 180
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3650
    Description: Days to retain noncurrent object versions before permanent deletion.
  IncompleteMultipartUploadExpirationDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: Days after which incomplete multipart uploads are aborted.

Resources:
  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AccessControl: LogDeliveryWrite
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerPreferred
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 365

  UploadsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref UploadsBucketName
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      CorsConfiguration:
        CorsRules:
          - AllowedHeaders: ['*']
            AllowedMethods: ['GET', 'PUT', 'POST', 'HEAD']
            AllowedOrigins: !Ref AllowedCorsOrigins
            ExposedHeaders: ['ETag', 'x-amz-version-id']
            MaxAge: 3000
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: !Ref IncompleteMultipartUploadExpirationDays
          - Id: NoncurrentVersionExpiration
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: !Ref NoncurrentVersionExpirationDays
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: !Sub "s3-access-logs/${UploadsBucketName}/"

  UploadsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UploadsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false
          - Sid: EnforceTLS12OrHigher
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              NumericLessThan:
                s3:TlsVersion: 1.2
          - Sid: DenyNonSigV4
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:signatureversion: 'AWS4'
          - Sid: DenyIncorrectEncryptionHeaderIfPresent
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEqualsIfExists:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms
          - Sid: DenyPublicACLs
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:PutObjectAcl
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}'
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIfExists:
                s3:x-amz-acl:
                  - public-read
                  - public-read-write
                  - authenticated-read

Outputs:
  UploadsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for application user uploads.
    Value: !Ref UploadsBucket
  UploadsBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket for application user uploads.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${UploadsBucket}'
  AccessLogsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that stores access logs.
    Value: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
